notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Hermes can use a Desktop Gateway now, and bots live in the sidebar. I also rebuilt the lists and sheets, and fixed a few bugs that had been sitting too long.

bullets.text: Hermes Bot Mode: connect a Desktop Gateway, pick a bot from the sidebar, and consecutive replies share one header.
Native grouped lists, iOS 26 glass, system fonts, and a tablet sidebar you can resize.
Replies stream with less hitching. LaTeX actually draws. Voice no longer answers itself. Polish is in the language list.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Apple On-Device runs on the phone. Use it in Direct chats, or in Open WebUI chats when you're offline. Voice calls start on the speaker and speak the answer, not the thinking. Hermes comes back after sitting idle, and I cleaned up a few chat bugs.

bullets.text: Apple On-Device: Direct chats locally, and Open WebUI chats when you're offline.
Voice calls: start on the speakerphone when nothing is plugged in. They skip reasoning and speak the whole answer.
Hermes: recovers finished runs after sitting idle and accepts PDFs. Skills autocomplete as you type. Citation links, note checklists, and Open WebUI 0.11.1 work.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Direct chats can call MCP servers from the phone. You approve each tool. Mac gets keyboard shortcuts and chat scrollbars. I also fixed Hermes approvals and Markdown quotes.

bullets.text: MCP servers: add them for Direct chats, including Apple On-Device. Approve tools once, for the session, or always. Insert prompts and resources into the chat.
Mac: keyboard shortcuts, sidebar hover, and right-click menus. Chats get fading scrollbars. Blockquotes render as quotes.
Hermes: streamed tool calls render as blocks. Approvals stick to the right run. Reopen a running Desktop session and the spinner is still there.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Open WebUI 0.11.3 works. I moved the warning for servers we don't support yet onto the new-chat screen, so it stops interrupting chats you already started.

bullets.text: Open WebUI 0.11.2 and 0.11.3: the app talks to them without a compatibility warning.
Unsupported server warning: only on a new chat. Existing conversations no longer show it.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Shared folders from Open WebUI show up in the sidebar. Reasoning streams while the model thinks, and the screen stays awake until the reply finishes. Long Hermes chats load again. I also fixed Android speakerphone and the iOS toolbar.

bullets.text: Shared folders: they appear in the sidebar. Chats someone else owns are read-only. Write access lets you start a new chat there.

Reasoning: it streams as the model thinks. The header shows how many seconds the model thought. The effort you pick for a model is sent with the request. Direct Ollama chats send previous thinking on the next turn.
Hermes: long Telegram sessions load even when reconnect fails. Too-large and missing sessions get their own error. You can dismiss the server version warning.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Reasoning stays in its own block as it streams. Think tags no longer appear in the answer. PDFs reach the model again. Speech turns into text after you stop talking, and the speaker button works. I also stopped the chat scrollbar from jumping.

bullets.text: Reasoning: it stays in its own block while the model writes. Think tags no longer appear in the answer. Tool blocks stay in the right place.

Voice and files: after you stop talking, Transcribing appears. Android device speech uses any installed recognizer. The speaker button stops the reply that is already playing. PDF attachments are sent to the model again. Citations can show page titles. If a proxy session expires, you can sign in again without logging out.
Hermes: you can check the Desktop Gateway during setup even when the toggle is still off.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Apple Private Cloud Compute is in the model picker and answers. On iPhone, Barge in lets you interrupt the assistant while it speaks. Open WebUI 0.11.4 works, and clearing the system prompt or the default model clears the saved value. I also fixed system lists that crashed, a black block next to the mic, and finished replies that showed Stop again.

bullets.text: Apple Private Cloud Compute: it shows in the model picker and answers. Apple On-Device and Private Cloud Compute use Apple's symbol.

Barge in: the iPhone voice sheet includes this toggle. The assistant keeps listening while it speaks, so you can interrupt it. Choosing an option in a system list no longer crashes the app. The black block next to the mic is gone when the row fits on screen. A finished reply stays finished after a refresh, and the Stop button stays off.
Open WebUI 0.11.4: the app talks to it without a compatibility warning. Clearing the system prompt or the default model clears the saved value.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Open WebUI replies stream more smoothly, with readable tool calls and task checklists that keep their progress. Voice calls keep the speaker route you chose. Shares and shortcuts open chats again without an Open WebUI account. I also refreshed chat and settings.

bullets.text: Open WebUI: answers keep updating after code or reasoning. Tool calls appear as blocks instead of raw markup, and task checklists keep their progress when you reopen a chat.
Voice: calls stay on the chosen speaker, and other audio returns to normal afterward. The speaker button reflects the route you actually hear.

Sharing and shortcuts: widgets, app shortcuts, Siri, and Android Assistant can open Direct or Hermes chats without an Open WebUI account. Shared files keep their names; Android speech recognition and keyboard layout recover more reliably.
Chat and settings: cleaner composer, sidebar, and message actions. Toolbar icons and settings follow your theme colors, with clearer contrast and screen reader labels.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Direct chats can search the web from your device, and images open in a gallery you can swipe through. You can switch between regenerated answers right below the reply. I also fixed Hermes setup, Android speech recognition, and a batch of chat and settings bugs.

bullets.text: Web search: Direct models without their own search can search and read pages from your device, including Ollama and Apple models that support tools. Choose the search engine, safe search, and region in settings. Direct models also show their maker's logo.
Images: swipe through attachments in chat and channels, zoom, and share. iOS uses Quick Look for supported images; Android can save to Pictures/Conduit.

Chat and channels: switch regenerated answers with the arrows below the reply. Direct chats keep earlier versions when reopened, and edited messages resend correctly. Markdown checkboxes render. Channel threads show replies, edits, deletions, and reactions live.

Hermes and voice: Desktop Gateway sign-in and connection tests work during setup, and replies no longer end before the first text arrives. Android speech retries a supported variant of your chosen language. Note dictation follows your speech-to-text setting.

Settings and accounts: native iOS settings follow your language, workspace details refresh after saving, and notification taps open the right conversation. Sign-out clears Direct and Hermes connections; keeping server details works. iOS dialogs and note checklists work again.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! You can keep several Open WebUI accounts signed in and switch between them, and save several Hermes connections. Calls can talk with a realtime voice you can interrupt. Open WebUI 0.12 works, including two-step sign-in, and more Open WebUI features no longer need Advanced.

bullets.text: Accounts: keep several Open WebUI accounts signed in, on one server or several, and switch from your profile or the new Accounts page at the top of Settings. Add any account or connection from one sheet. A server can have several addresses, such as LAN, Tailscale and a public proxy; the app uses the first one that answers.

Hermes: save several named connections, such as Home and Research, and switch between them from the sidebar, settings or Accounts. A chat whose session belongs to another connection offers to switch to it.

Realtime calls: on Open WebUI 0.12, Direct and the Hermes Desktop Gateway, calls can talk with an OpenAI realtime voice, and speaking over it stops it. Choose a Voice provider in Audio settings for Direct and Apple chats. Server speech to text and text to speech follow each chat's own backend.

Open WebUI 0.12: the app works without a compatibility warning. Two-step verification at sign-in works, including setup and recovery codes. Skill export, folder sharing, enforced temporary chats and tool approvals follow 0.12.

Open WebUI features: the draft queue, code interpreter, branches, chat audience, project folders, sharing, channel members and calendar no longer need Advanced. Advanced adds model comparison, scheduled tasks, webhooks and data controls. Large chats no longer download again on every open, and the reasoning effort you choose sticks.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Open WebUI 0.12.2 works, and channels show the apps that answer in them and can notify you for mentions only. Voice calls keep going through background noise and avatar gestures, and the speaker button works from the start of Android calls.

bullets.text: Open WebUI 0.12.2: the app works without a compatibility warning. Chats a realtime call starts get a generated title and tags, following your title and tag settings.

Channels: messages from apps show the app's name, cards, buttons and links. Pressing a button sends it to the app, and replies only you can see appear under the message until you dismiss them. Set a channel or direct message to Mentions only to skip badges and notifications unless you're mentioned.

Voice calls: background noise no longer cuts off a realtime voice mid-sentence; it pauses, and carries on if nothing was said. Avatar gestures no longer hold up replies for three seconds. On Android, the speaker button works from the start of a call, and a call no longer blocks your own phone calls for its first two minutes.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Open WebUI 0.12.4 works, and you can share answers, mark chats unread, and tap to play videos in chat. Server dictation keeps every word, sharing to Conduit on iOS brings the real file, and back on Android goes to the chat list.

bullets.text: Open WebUI 0.12.4: the app works without a compatibility warning, and a sentence split by a pause in a realtime call is answered once. Folders stay open or closed as you left them, here and on the web. Mark a chat unread from the chat list, and chats marked unread on the web show unread here. Filters set to start enabled are on in new chats, images from MCP tools load, every model offers the Effort picker, and a function can ask to move the chat to another model.

Chats: videos show a card and load when you tap Play. Share… in a response's ⋯ menu sends its text, and Copy and Share both take the version on screen. On iOS, long-pressing a long message keeps Edit, Copy and Delete in view, and a long channel message no longer pushes its thread replies off screen.

Sharing and dictation: on iOS, screenshots, Files documents and images from Safari arrive as the real file, and the chat shows even if Settings was open. Server dictation keeps everything you said, to the last word, even if you tap stop early or talk for longer than 90 seconds.

Android and accounts: back goes to the chat list, and the assistant opens on a ready new chat and keeps working after a reboot. An edited server or Hermes connection is named after its new address, and Direct providers stay in reach next to Hermes.

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Open WebUI 0.13 and 0.12.5 work: MCP Apps open in chats, terminals update live and preview ports in the app, and notes can have pages. Listening to a response opens a player you can pause and skip, unsent drafts survive a restart, and there's a new sliding sidebar in Appearance settings.

bullets.text: Open WebUI 0.13: the app works without a compatibility warning, and temporary chats work and keep replying after a reconnect. An MCP tool's app opens right in the chat and asks you before each tool it runs. Chats waiting for a tool approval show a raised hand in the chat list. Switch workspace tools off and on, and knowledge base uploads follow the server's file limits and say why one was refused; a base's owner can set File limits of its own. Webhooks saved on 0.12 can be edited again.

Terminal: on Open WebUI 0.13, files and ports update as they change. A port opens in Conduit's own page with back, forward, reload and Open in browser, and links on it work. On iOS, previews also get through a sign-in proxy in front of Open WebUI.

Open WebUI 0.12.5: the app works without a compatibility warning. The model you pick in a chat is saved with it, and switching models keeps the tools and filters you turned on or off. Answers cut off by a server restart no longer show as still being written. Files a model shows and images it makes through the Responses API appear in the reply, and usage counts every step of a reply and says when its figures may be low. Moving a chat to a folder keeps its date, and in a shared chat Stop is offered only for your own reply.

Notes: on Open WebUI 0.12.5 a note can have several pages. Tap the page name under the title, or Pages in the menu, to switch; edits save to the page you're on. Attached files show as cards in the text, and a new recording goes in where the cursor is. Pages are added, renamed and moved on the web.

Sliding sidebar: turn it on in Appearance settings. The chat slides aside to show your history, with backend tabs at the bottom next to New Chat, and Notes, Terminal and Channels open in place of the chat with a back button. On iOS, menus, switches, alerts, banners, text selection and the magnifier are now the system's own.

Listening and drafts: Listen on a response opens a player to pause, stop and jump 15 seconds back or forward, with server and device voices alike, and the voice list filters by language. Unsent text and recordings stay with each chat after a restart, and a recovered recording can be transcribed, exported or discarded. On iOS, the Lock Screen shows a recording in progress with a Stop button.

Chats and settings: Generate Title in an Open WebUI chat's menu names it from the conversation. Pick and order the actions under a response with Message actions in Chat settings. Appearance settings can hide the composer's Notes button and the background behind citations. A cloud icon shows when a chat's live updates disconnect, with details and Retry, and long drafts keep the composer's buttons in view.
